items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Last time I saw her she was singing with Georgie Auld.

ctx.x: She's married to -- her husband writes a lot of tunes. What's his name out on the West Coast? He wrote Angel Eyes and all of those things, some fine tunes. But --
Last time I saw her she was singing with Georgie Auld. That was a long time ago.
